Last week, simple rules for visitor flow
This section explains the main rule first, then the reasons
Companion Animal Travel Desk - Service Records and Traveler Handling

This section sets the standard for calm intake, accurate records, and orderly movement of travelers with companion animals. Staff must keep the desk clear, confirm the travel file, and pass all requests through the senior coordinator when a decision is needed. The passenger coordinator gives the traveler the required steps and checks that each record is complete before service continues. 

At intake, staff speak plainly, review the papers in hand, and record only what is needed for the file. <<FACT F085>> The traveler is then guided to the next step without delay, and any exception is noted in the log. If arrival pickup needs escalation, staff follow the same controlled process, use the proper channel, and keep the exchange brief. <<FACT F107>> All entries must remain readable, current, and consistent with the desk record. 

When a case is unusual, staff refer it at once to the senior coordinator. For questions about handling, routing, or record correction, contact the senior coordinator or the passenger coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
